name: Ranma 1/2 - Byakuran Aika
source:
The game features an original story centering on a new character, Arisa Nanjo. After Ranma Saotome's friends go missing, it is up to him to track them down.

[From [url=http://ranma.wikia.com/wiki/Ranma_%C2%BD:_Byakuran_Aika]ranma.wikia.com[/url]]
translation:
游戏采用原创剧情，以新角色南条亚里沙为中心。早乙女乱马的朋友们失踪后，追查他们下落的重任便落在乱马身上。

[摘自[url=http://ranma.wikia.com/wiki/Ranma_%C2%BD:_Byakuran_Aika]ranma.wikia.com[/url]]
